notes: Temporary public documentation bridge until the merged private canonical method catalog is consumed automatically. Existing names are patched by name; new names are appended.

entries.name: when_pressed
entries.zh: 註冊按下事件的便利寫法
entries.en: Beginner-friendly wrapper for a pressed callback

entries.name: when_released
entries.zh: 註冊放開事件的便利寫法
entries.en: Beginner-friendly wrapper for a released callback

entries.name: servo
entries.zh: 立即設定預設或命名 Servo 的角度
entries.en: Set the default or named servo angle immediately

entries.name: servo_move_to
entries.zh: 讓預設或命名 Servo 分段平滑移動到指定角度
entries.en: Move the default or named servo smoothly to an angle

entries.name: servo_sweep
entries.zh: 讓預設或命名 Servo 在兩個角度間持續掃動
entries.en: Sweep the default or named servo between two angles

entries.name: servo_stop
entries.zh: 停止預設或命名 Servo 的掃動工作
entries.en: Stop sweeping the default or named servo

entries.name: servo_get_angle
entries.zh: 取得預設或命名 Servo 最近可確認的角度
entries.en: Get the latest confirmed angle for the default or named servo

entries.name: servo_release
entries.zh: 釋放預設或命名 Servo 的 PWM 輸出
entries.en: Release PWM output for the default or named servo

entries.name: is_motion_detected
entries.zh: 判斷 PIR 是否偵測到人體或熱源移動
entries.en: Check whether PIR motion is detected

entries.name: on_motion_detected
entries.zh: PIR 由無移動變成偵測到移動時觸發事件
entries.en: Trigger a callback when PIR motion is detected

entries.name: on_motion_cleared
entries.zh: PIR 由偵測到移動回到無移動時觸發事件
entries.en: Trigger a callback when PIR motion clears

entries.name: light
entries.zh: 讀取校準後 0–100 相對亮度；0=暗、100=亮
entries.en: Read calibrated relative light level from 0 to 100

entries.name: sound_level
entries.zh: 讀取 0–100 相對聲音強度，不是 dB
entries.en: Read relative sound level from 0 to 100; not dB

entries.name: joystick
entries.zh: 讀取搖桿 X/Y，回傳標準化 (x, y)
entries.en: Read normalized joystick X/Y as (x, y)

entries.name: led_set_brightness
entries.zh: 設定 RGB 亮度的相容名稱；等同 brightness()
entries.en: Compatibility name for brightness()

entries.name: led_show_one
entries.zh: 顯示單顆 RGB 的相容名稱；等同 led()
entries.en: Compatibility name for led()

entries.name: led_show_all
entries.zh: 顯示全部 RGB 的相容名稱；等同 led_all()
entries.en: Compatibility name for led_all()

entries.name: led_show_range
entries.zh: 顯示 RGB 範圍的相容名稱；等同 led_range()
entries.en: Compatibility name for led_range()

entries.name: led_turn_off
entries.zh: 關閉 RGB 的相容名稱；委派給 led_off()
entries.en: Compatibility name that delegates to led_off()

entries.name: led_clear
entries.zh: 停止目前 RGB 動畫；與 led_off() 的停止並清黑語意不同
entries.en: Stop the current RGB animation without the stronger clear-to-black semantics of led_off()

entries.name: sound
entries.zh: 依名稱播放內建短音效
entries.en: Play a built-in short sound effect by name

entries.name: stop_music
entries.zh: 停止目前歌曲或旋律播放
entries.en: Stop current song or melody playback

entries.name: beep
entries.zh: bee() 的相容名稱
entries.en: Compatibility name for bee()

entries.name: play_tone
entries.zh: tone() 的相容名稱
entries.en: Compatibility name for tone()

entries.name: servo_set_angle
entries.zh: servo() 的底層／相容名稱
entries.en: Low-level/compatibility name for servo()

entries.name: clear_oled
entries.zh: clear() 的底層名稱
entries.en: Low-level name for clear()

entries.name: clear_screen
entries.zh: clear() 的相容名稱
entries.en: Compatibility name for clear()

entries.name: send_text
entries.zh: 送出 OLED 單行文字命令
entries.en: Send a low-level OLED text command

entries.name: start_flash_text
entries.signature: m.start_flash_text(text, x=0, y=0, size=1, period=500, duration=0)
entries.zh: flash_text() 的底層名稱
entries.en: Low-level name for flash_text()

entries.name: on
entries.zh: 相容層事件 API；感測器更新時執行 callback
entries.en: Compatibility event API that runs a callback on sensor updates

entries.name: on_enter
entries.zh: 數位狀態由 0 轉 1 時執行 callback；相容於 on_pressed()
entries.en: Run a callback when a digital state changes 0 to 1; compatible with on_pressed()

entries.name: on_leave
entries.zh: 數位狀態由 1 轉 0 時執行 callback；相容於 on_released()
entries.en: Run a callback when a digital state changes 1 to 0; compatible with on_released()

entries.name: on_light_above
entries.zh: 光線向上跨越門檻時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger when light rises across a threshold

entries.name: on_light_below
entries.zh: 光線向下跨越門檻時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger when light falls across a threshold

entries.name: on_sound_above
entries.zh: 聲音強度向上跨越門檻時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger when sound level rises across a threshold

entries.name: on_sound_below
entries.zh: 聲音強度向下跨越門檻時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger when sound level falls across a threshold

entries.name: is_joystick_pressed
entries.zh: 判斷搖桿 SW 按鍵目前是否按下
entries.en: Check whether the joystick switch is pressed

entries.name: on_joystick_pressed
entries.zh: 搖桿 SW 按下時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger a callback when the joystick switch is pressed

entries.name: on_joystick_released
entries.zh: 搖桿 SW 放開時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger a callback when the joystick switch is released

entries.name: calibrate_joystick
entries.zh: 以多次取樣校正搖桿中心值
entries.en: Calibrate the joystick center from repeated samples

entries.name: line_left
entries.zh: 讀取左側循跡感測狀態
entries.en: Read the left line-tracking sensor state

entries.name: line_right
entries.zh: 讀取右側循跡感測狀態
entries.en: Read the right line-tracking sensor state

entries.name: on_line_change
entries.zh: 任一循跡狀態改變時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger when either line-tracking state changes

entries.name: on_line_left
entries.zh: 進入 left 循跡狀態時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger when the line state becomes left

entries.name: on_line_right
entries.zh: 進入 right 循跡狀態時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger when the line state becomes right

entries.name: on_line_both
entries.zh: 進入 both 循跡狀態時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger when the line state becomes both

entries.name: on_line_clear
entries.zh: 進入 none／離線狀態時觸發 callback
entries.en: Trigger when the line state becomes none/clear

entries.name: close
entries.zh: 停止 Runtime 或背景資源並關閉 Mango 物件
entries.en: Stop runtime/background resources and close the Mango object

entries.name: send_command
entries.zh: 送出進階 Runtime 命令；一般學生程式不需直接使用
entries.en: Send an advanced Runtime command; ordinary learner code normally does not need this
